title: Reading a catalog
hints: Add xml tags so the structs match the document: name and id are attributes (,attr), and each <book> becomes an element of Books.
A path in a tag reaches into nested elements: `xml:"meta>year"` reads <meta><year>. A field `XMLName xml.Name `xml:"library"`` makes Unmarshal reject any other root element.
Then ParseLibrary is just: var lib Library; err := xml.Unmarshal(data, &lib); return lib, err
